BEGIN DOMAIN
(define (domain gripper-strips)
  (:requirements :strips :typing)
  (:types robot gripper room object)
  (:predicates
    (at-robby ?r - robot ?room - room)
    (free ?r - robot ?g - gripper)
    (at ?o - object ?room - room)
    (carry ?r - robot ?o - object ?g - gripper)
  )

  (:action move
    :parameters (?r - robot ?from - room ?to - room)
    :precondition (at-robby ?r ?from)
    :effect (and
      (at-robby ?r ?to)
      (not (at-robby ?r ?from))
    )
  )

  (:action pick
    :parameters (?r - robot ?g - gripper ?o - object ?room - room)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?o ?room)
      (at-robby ?r ?room)
      (free ?r ?g)
    )
    :effect (and
      (carry ?r ?o ?g)
      (not (at ?o ?room))
      (not (free ?r ?g))
    )
  )

  (:action drop
    :parameters (?r - robot ?g - gripper ?o - object ?room - room)
    :precondition (and
      (carry ?r ?o ?g)
      (at-robby ?r ?room)
    )
    :effect (and
      (at ?o ?room)
      (free ?r ?g)
      (not (carry ?r ?o ?g))
    )
  )
)
END DOMAIN
